advices.diagnosis: The class has a low cohesion score (LCOM4 = 2), indicating that its methods operate on disjoint sets of attributes: formatting (title, width), customer description, and data‑mailing (repository, mailer). While the method count and complexity are modest, the mixed responsibilities inflate the distinct class coupling (DCC = 2) and prevent a single, clear purpose.

suggestions.title: Extract business logic to a ReportService and keep ReportView as pure presenter

advices.risk_notes: Call sites that instantiate ReportView will need to supply a ReportService, which may be a breaking change. Tests that mock repository or mailer directly on ReportView must be updated to mock ReportService instead. Introducing a new class adds a layer of indirection, so ensure that the service is correctly wired in the dependency injection container to avoid runtime import errors.
